newsitem.title: USA: Servico files for 10 mln share offering.
newsitem.headline: Servico files for 10 mln share offering.

text.p: Servico Inc said Monday that it has filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 10 million shares of common stock.
The company said it intends to use the proceeds of the offering primarily to retire outstanding debt.
Servico also said that it intends to file an application to list its common stock on the New York Stock Exchange. It now trades on the American Stock Exchange.
Servico owns or manages fifty-nine hotels in 22 states, which are affiliated with nationally recognized chains.
